{{Top|leg}}
A '''disrupter ray''' was used to immobilize a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] without doing it any permanent damage. The ray could be fired from a handheld device.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Their heavy armor will come through first. Position the disrupter rays to knock out the gravity pulses.|General Ceel in the revised rough draft of ''The Phantom Menace''|<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref>}}
In the revised rough draft of the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]] orders the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] to use disrupter rays against the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="Insider's Guide" />
